what: blind reading of the seven quoted analytic premises of Axiom's BGP212 development against the papers they cite (step 3 of the plan sealed 2026-11-12). Readings, not decisions.

says_about_its_sources: 'The declarations, rather than their source descriptions, specify the exact hypotheses of the challenge.' (l. 22-24)
'The bound 212 does not appear in [1] or [2]; [2, Theorem 1] states H1 <= 240 at k = 49.' (l. 697)
'The dimension k = 45 is specific to this certificate; [2, Theorem 1] is proved at k = 49.' (l. 514)
gap212Cap: the cap values are specific to this datum; [2] takes B = 0.15, 0.15, 0.17... at delta = 0.028, eps = 0.0075, k = 49 (l. 443-445)
Kregion departs from the printed region of [2] Definition 5 (l. 402-403; Gap212Certificate out of scope)
CoprimeBelow's docstring equates p <= x with [2]'s (a, P(x)) = 1, but [2] defines P(y) over p < y; and cites [1] Definition 2.2 for the primitive class of [1] Definition 2.6 (docstring slips only)
